tools.name: trends___get_context
tools.description: What people are posting, reading and betting about a keyword right now. Returns recent posts, videos, news stories, discussions and prediction markets per source, with engagement (views, likes, score) and top comments. Use it to explain why something is trending or what the conversation says; get_ti

tools.name: trends___get_growth
tools.description: Point-to-point growth for a keyword on one or more sources. Each window is a preset string (12M, 3M, YTD, and the other listed periods). Values are on a 0-100 scale, plus absolute volume when available. Designed for growth questions; for charting or custom math, get_time_series provides the full ser

tools.name: trends___get_time_series
tools.description: Full historical series for one keyword and one source (0-100 values, plus volume when available). Suited for charting or custom math. Live 'what's trending now' boards are on get_top_trends. get_growth answers most growth questions with less data. Returns a plan-limit message when the request is rat

tools.name: trends___get_top_posts
tools.description: Live top posts for one hashtag on one social source. Fetched live on every call; nothing is stored. For when the user already has a hashtag and wants the posts winning on it. get_top_trends ranks the hashtags themselves. Returns a plan-limit message when the request is rate limited or the monthly qu

tools.name: trends___get_top_trends
tools.description: Live top-trending board for exactly one feed type. No keyword. For 'Amazon Best Sellers by Category', 'Google Trends by Category', 'Pinterest Trending by Category', 'Top Websites', 'Substack by Category', and 'TikTok Trending Hashtags by Category', category selects the board. Default sort is current

tools.name: trends___get_usage
tools.description: Shows your plan, requests used this month, requests left, and when it resets. Free: does not use a request. Call it when the user asks about their limit or after a limit error.

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trends___get_context, trends___get_growth, trends___get_reviews, trends___get_time_series, trends___get_top_trends · Private data: trends___get_top_trends · Public sink: trends___get_reviews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trends___get_context, trends___get_growth, trends___get_reviews, trends___get_time_series, trends___get_top_trends · Private data: trends___get_top_trends · Public sink: trends___get_reviews

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "trends___get_context" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
